# Russian Empire: 400.
wif_sme_form_RUE = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_state = { OR = { state = 400 } wif_sme_side_owns = yes } }
		every_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 400 } wif_sme_side_owns = yes }
			transfer_state_to = RUE
			add_core_of = RUE
			remove_core_of = SME
			remove_core_of = ZWF
		}
		RUE = {
			if = {
				limit = { owns_state = 400 }
				set_capital = { state = 400 }
			}
			load_focus_tree = { tree = wif_post_sme_warlord_tree keep_completed = no }
			inherit_technology = event_target:wif_sme_south
			set_research_slots = 3
			set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
			set_popularities = { neutrality = 70 communism = 10 fascism = 15 democratic = 5 }
			wif_become_absolute_monarchy = yes
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Vladimir III Romanov"
				picture = "GFX_portrait_SME_vladimir_iii"
				expire = "1975.1.1"
				ideology = wif_absolute_monarchism
				traits = { }
			}
			wif_apply_subideology_modifiers = yes
			set_stability = 0.35
			set_war_support = 0.3
			wif_sme_ruin_country = yes
		}
		wif_sme_kirov_becomes_vyatka = yes
		event_target:wif_sme_south = {
			transfer_units_fraction = {
				target = RUE
				size = 0
				army_ratio = 0.1
				navy_ratio = 0
				air_ratio = 0.1
				stockpile_ratio = 0.1
				keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
			}
		}
		# The player of the government it left may follow it.
		event_target:wif_sme_south = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				country_event = { id = wif_sme_switch.1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
